cases.refreshed: Bridge is great exercise for your brain! This bridge program is designed for adults who are passionate about bridge and are looking to enhance their game with regular practice and social interaction. The atmosphere is relaxed and welcoming, making it an ideal setting to engage with fellow bridge enthusiasts and to refine your strategies. Participants should be familiar with bridge terminology and have experience in playing the hand as instructions or assistance will not be provided. Free. Seating is limited; registration required. This program is generously sponsored by the Friends of the Cambrian Library!

events.title: Asistencia para buscar trabajo y crear un resumen (currículum)

cases.refreshed: ¿Necesitas ayuda con tu resumen (currículum)? ¿Necesita ayuda para buscar oportunidades de empleo? Reúnase personalmente con un miembro del personal de la biblioteca (uno a uno) para aprender cómo: Crear o actualizar tu resumen (currículum); Navegar por sitios web de solicitudes de empleo; Llenar formas de solicitudes de trabajo; Aprender técnicas de entrevista; Obtener ayuda para registrarse en Serv Safe (Tarjeta para manipuladores de alimentos); *Desafortunadamente, no podemos ayudar con ninguna información personal/sensible (por ejemplo, número de seguro social, información bancaria, formularios de impuestos, etc.). Este es un programa presencial organizado en la Sucursal de la Biblioteca Latinoamericana. El personal de la biblioteca estará allí para guiarte en todo, pero serás tú quien controle la computadora. Gratis. Se requiere registro. Para registrarse, llame al (408) 294-1237.

events.title: Playdates for Children and Their Caregivers

cases.refreshed: Join us every Wednesday for weekly playdates. Kids get to practice early social skills like sharing, taking turns, imitation of play, and joint attention while caregivers get a chance to connect. Don't miss out on this chance to celebrate the joys of play while connecting with other families in the community. It's a wonderful way to learn through play and create lasting memories together! 1st Wednesday: Cars; 2nd Wednesday: Superhero Obstacle Course (ages 3-8); 3rd Wednesday: LEGO Duplo Blocks; 4th Wednesday: Cars; 5th Wednesday: LEGO Duplo Blocks. Recommended for children ages 2 – 6 years old.

cases.refreshed: Please join us for Family Movie Club at the Joyce Ellington Branch Library as we watch Wonder, a movie that follows August Pullman, a 10-year-old boy born with facial differences, as he attends a mainstream school for the first time and inspires his classmates and community to choose kindness Families are invited to relax and enjoy this fun movie together in a welcoming community setting. Popcorn will be provided, and we will have coloring pages available for those who prefer a quiet activity during the movie. Free. No registration required. The program is sponsored by the Friends of the Joyce Ellington Library.

events.title: Create CU: Jumbo Bookmarks and Open Studio

cases.refreshed: Friday, December 11, 7 PM Room 201 Join us for more creative exploration with art materials. Bring your unfinished artwork, sketchbook or journal and your curiosity. Or work on the prompt for the night: Mix Media Jumbo Bookmark – create a 3 x 9 bookmark using acrylic paint, collage, pens, markers and more. Supplies will be provided but you can bring your own art journal or favorite supplies Sign-up online November 28, 2026 at 10 AM. For accessibility accommodations (e.g., ASL), please fill out the online form at sccld.org/accessibility 7+ days prior to the event. If you need assistance with the form, speak with a staff member at your local library, call (408) 540-3945, or email us at ask@sccl.org.

events.title: Tiny Talkers: Public Speaking, Speech & Debate Workshop

cases.refreshed: Children ages 6 & up are invited to join us for an introductory workshop on public speaking and debate. This is a great way for young students in grades K through 6 to gain confidence in speaking to others and help improve literacy. Participants will respond to various prompts, experience fun drills, work in groups, and more! This workshop will be facilitated by High School volunteers with Speech & Debate experience. Recommended for ages 6 to 12. Free. No registration required.
